cross_fitting: five folds: outcome F_k; discovery/decision F_(k+1); model-fit remaining three
finite_intervention: project raw embedding h through the candidate projector; logits use W(I-P)h+b, exactly matching the authorized AGDI alpha=1 intervention

gates.H1: LCB95 persistence-specific>0 and Holm one-sided p<0.05
gates.H2: UCB95 u_spec<0 and Holm one-sided p<0.05
gates.H3: local random-control LCB>1 and p<0.05; finite-ratio LCB>1 and Holm p<0.05
gates.H5: all leave-one-fold-out means>0, all leave-one-subject-out means>0, >=60% nonnegative subjects
gates.actionable_harmful: H1 AND H2 AND H3 AND H4 AND H5
gates.competence: mean subject BA>=0.60 AND LCB95>0.55 AND >=70% subjects BA>0.5

multiplicity: Holm separately across four primary blocks for H1,H2,H3-finite,H4 and protected-utility
